x: Our "A" Team was placed 6th out of 35 teams with a total of 68 points. The winner was O'Gorman of St. Albans in a very good time and Mitcham won the team race by one point from Herne Hill.

As the Manchester Guardian stated "Jack Brown of Belgrave Harriers........made a startling entry into the ranks of short distance road runners when he took second place to O'Gorman in the Walton A.C. 10 miles event".

Albans' O'Gorman,at that time well behind us.Jack gave Heywood of H.H.H a fright and was unlucky not to catch him before Handcross. The traffic here was exceptionally thick and a slight contretemps with a large car might well have proved serious to our runners.

The race seemed to resolve itself quite rapidly into two fierce battles, between O'Gorman, Brown, Keily, Hicks, Lambert and Haslam on the one hand and a close bunch of a dozen, including our own trio, Colin Collis, Eric Gebbett and Len Bishop on the other.

It should also be recorded that other notabilities on this stage were Sando, Driver, Heatley, O'Gorman, Keily and Ingles, all of whom beat the previous record and all of whom gained assistance in battling with the opposition.
Young Alan Black, undeterred by the star names around him, ran a very sensible 3rd stage, dropping places only to Sando and O'Gorman, each of whom broke the course record.
Some tremendously fast running ensued and the winner (O'Gorman of St. Albans) covered the course in 1h.43m.26s.- 3m.25s. faster than the previous record.

Bill Kerr ran a fine(9:25.0)2 miles to beat O'Gorman and Macey of St. Albans, but unfortunately we were short of a runner for the team race one good man could have swung both the Senior and total scores in our favour.

This group stayed together for most of the first lap when Steer made a break pursued by O'Gorman of Poly. These two opened up a lead of 50 yards over Bill Kerr, Laurie O'Hara and Pat Bradley, amongst others.
Albans are appearing with O'Gorman and Thorpe as the examples. Let us get back before we drop from the picture like many other clubs - the writing is on the wall!
